memory_bridge: The bay crossing retrieves On ベイ and America; the bowl at home retrieves the native grain-word 米（こめ）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 米国（べいこく）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Four rice grains sail across a bay toward the United States; bay → ベイ in 米国（べいこく）.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 米（こめ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Back home, the four scattered grains gather into a bowl: 米（こめ）, the native word for husked rice.
